label: Empty causal relation on integer event…: IndependentCauses x y is False for all integers x,y
term: empty causal relation on integer event times
definition: independentCauses x y is False for all integers x,y. It is separate from the usual temporal precedence relation x < y; unbounded temporal precedence therefore does not imply a descending independentCauses series.
note: Analyst control only. Does not identify time points as physical events in reality or claim an actual absence of causes.
